rules.description: Ministries or Departments wishing to onboard their scholarship schemes for an academic year must submit a formal request to NSP with detailed scheme guidelines.
rules.condition: When a Ministry/Department desires to onboard its scholarship scheme(s) in an AY
rules.outcome: They must make a formal request to NSP and provide detailed guidelines of the scheme(s).
rules.evidence_quote: any Ministry/Department desirous to on-board their scholarship scheme(s) in an AY shall make a formal request to NSP for the same providing detailed guidelines of the scheme(s).

rules.description: The concerned Ministry/Department must provide a detailed FAQ that includes possible scheme-specific queries, clarifications, and contact details of relevant officials.
rules.condition: When the Ministry/Department submits the formal request
rules.outcome: They must provide a detailed FAQ with scheme-specific queries/clarifications and contact details of relevant officials.
rules.evidence_quote: The concerned Ministry/Department will also provide a detailed FAQ incorporating possible scheme specific queries/clarification along-with contact details of relevant officials.

rules.description: The Ministry/Department should adjust its scheme guidelines to align with existing procedures of the identified schemes.
rules.condition: When preparing the scheme guidelines for onboarding
rules.outcome: They are suggested to make necessary procedural changes to accommodate all existing procedures of the identified schemes.
rules.evidence_quote: The concerned Ministry/Department is suggested to make necessary procedural changes in the scheme guidelines to accommodate all the existing procedures of the identified schemes.
